metadata.article_title: Liability of estate of deceased partner.

article.title: Liability of estate of deceased partner.
article.content: Where under a contract between the partners the firm is not dissolved by the death of a partner, the estate of a deceased partner is not liable for any act of the firm done after his death.
article.html:
35Liability of estate of deceased partner.

Section 35 · Chapter V · page 10 of the Act

Where under a contract between the partners the firm is not dissolved by the death of a partner, the estate of a deceased partner is not liable for any act of the firm done after his death.
